'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Chris Gogolen DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Gogolen]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Unlucky 13th DS deck'''. L53 Ability, Ability, Ability (V) over Imperial Barrage; L59 Disarmed (V) over Limited Resources. Galen, Secret Apprentice → Galen Marek.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) (Virtual Block 2)|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
